issue_context.title: How to specify the SecureOn password in a Link file?
issue_context.body:
A link file allows configuring the WakeOnLan policy of network interface with the `WakeOnLan=` setting.
The manual page [systemd.link(5)](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/systemd.link.html) says it's also possible to enable a password with `WakeOnLan=secureon`, however it doesn't mention how to specify the password itself. How should I configure the password?
comments: @rnhmjoj I introduced a new setting to set the password in #20926. But I have not tested. If possible, could you test the PR? Thank you.

review_comments: one idea: if this returns ENOENT, maybe fallback to `read_credential("wol.password", …)`, i.e. without the basename prefix. I figure some people might not be interested to set a per-link wol password,  but only a fixed one that applies to all links
